description:
Create an alert that tells the user when a new period of an indicator is published for a place, or when a published value is revised. Use it for "notify me when Spain's CPI is out", "tell me when Texas unemployment is revised", "alert me when my saved chart gets new data".
Target: indicator and place (as in get_value), optionally source to follow one publisher only; or workspace_item, the id of a saved chart or table, which follows every place of the item (Pro plan, like the workspace).
Channels: "email" (default) to the account's own address, one message per release run or a daily digest with email_mode "daily"; "webhook" to an HTTPS URL, signed with Standard Webhooks headers (Builder and Pro); "feed" for agents that poll list_changes instead.
Examples: {"indicator": "cpi_annual_change", "place": "Spain"}. {"indicator": "unemployment_rate", "place": "Texas", "events": ["revision"]}. {"workspace_item": "wsp_3f9a...", "channel": "webhook", "webhook_url": "https://example.com/hooks/invokely"}.
Returns {alert: {id, label, target, events, channel, status, ...}, created, secret?, warnings?}. secret (webhooks only) is shown once: tell the user to store it to verify signatures. Free keeps 5 alerts, Builder 50, Pro 500. Alert calls do not use the monthly allowance.

email_mode.description: channel "email" only. "instant" (default): one email per release run; "daily": one digest a day.

events.description: What to be told about: "new_period" (a period not published before) and "revision" (a published value or its status changed). Default both.

indicator.description: Indicator id, for example "cpi_annual_change" or "unemployment_rate". Use search_indicators when unsure.

label.description: Optional name shown in emails and lists.

place.description: Place name or id, for example "Spain", "Texas", "es-mun-08121".

source.description: Optional source id (the source.id of get_value), to follow one publisher only. Omit to hear about every source of the series.

webhook_url.description: channel "webhook" only. A public HTTPS URL that accepts POST requests.

workspace_item.description: Instead of indicator and place: a saved chart or table id from workspace_list.

name: subscribe_alert
title: Create a release alert
